name: Attention-velocity ignition — accel spike vol-gated (4h, quiet-tape onset)
rationale: MECHANISM: the attention-onset lead is cleanest when it fires into a QUIET tape — a fresh accel spike while realized vol is still low means the crowd has not yet moved price, so the informational lead is maximal; once vol is already elevated the move is half-priced. social_volume_accel = ln(v_t/v_{t-1}) leads UP at k=1-3d on small floats. Entry LONG when accel clears a fitted spike floor AND vol_realized is BELOW a fitted ceiling (onset, not late). Exit on accel decay or stop/TP/time. DISCONFIRMER: the low-vol gate must ADD incremental edge over the plain accel spike (ablation: accel+vol-gate must beat accel-alone OOS); if a low-vol filter alone (buy any quiet coin) matches it, the attention is redundant, KILL. Time-shuffle the attention series — survival = price autocorrelation, KILL. Net of 4h round-trip fees.
catalyst: attention acceleration firing into a still-quiet tape before price has moved
